messages:
todd.h: Quick note month-end close: we have a prepaid Dedicated contract where customer paid for 12 months up front but billing recognized entire amount on invoice at generation. Need to set up proper deferral schedule (GL 2105) and ensure earned revenue is recognized monthly per contract.

emily.s: Which customer and amount?

todd.h: BigRetailCo, invoice PREPAY-2026-011, amount $360,000 for 12-month term starting Feb 1. Billing has one-line revenue recognition entry.

nate.d: For NetSuite entry, we'll create an adjusting JE to move recognized revenue to deferred. Suggest: Dr Service Revenue (4100) $360,000 / Cr Deferred Revenue (2105) $360,000. Then recognition schedule $30,000/mo Feb 1 - Jan 31.

toni.p: Audit note: attach signed SOW and proof of payment. Also need to document who authorized the JE. Policy: prepaids over $250k require VP Finance approval. Todd, can you get sign-off?

todd.h: VP Finance (toni.p) here. I authorize.

audit-bot: Auto-flag: PREPAY-2026-011 > $250k, VP approval required. Approval recorded by toni.p at 1767325300.

emily.s: OK I'll post the JE with supporting docs and label it "Prepaid dedicated contract reclass to deferred revenue". Also will add memo for revenue schedule tab.

nate.d: Note for recognition: first month's revenue recognized Feb 1; close teams will need to ensure partial-month recognition is handled if subscription starts mid-period. This one aligns with start of month so $30k clean.

todd.h: Billing will adjust the invoice template to flag prepaids so they generate deferred schedule automatically going forward. ETA EOD.

emily.s: Thanks. I'll run the rev schedule update after JE posts and include it in the close pack.

nate.d: Also scanned AR and found one other prepaid >$250k, I'll open a ticket.

emily.s: Good catch. Add to the close binder.
